name: Primark
notes: 2026-10-29: www.primark.com/en-us (homepage and /en-us/stores), corporate.primark.com and abf.co.uk (parent Associated British Foods) all return a 'Challenge Validation' bot check to curl (StylodexBot UA) and to WebFetch. robots.txt returns 403. One try each, no workaround. Status unverified: a human must open the US site.

Wikipedia (Primark): founded 13 June 1969 in Dublin as Penneys; HQ Arthur Ryan House, Parnell Street, Dublin; parent Associated British Foods (spin-off announced April 2026, due by late 2027); products 'Clothing, cosmetics, housewares'; 'In 2015, Primark opened its first United States shop, in Boston'; shops by country as of 16 July 2026: United States 43. Online: click-and-collect launched November 2022 (UK); in September 2026 Primark announced plans for a home delivery service in Britain. No US home delivery is described.

Press, Sept 2026: FashionUnited ('Primark operating just under 50 US stores following debut openings in Georgia') says the Lawrenceville, Georgia store brings the US total to 47 and quotes Kevin Tulip, President of Primark US: 'Primark's signature everyday essentials at affordable prices' and 'quality fashion at exceptional value'. RetailBoss (Sept 6 2026): first Minnesota store (Mall of America, Sept 3 2026) made 46 US stores. known_for is built from the Primark US president's wording.
us_stores left empty: the rule needs Primark's own store locator or its parent's site, both behind the bot check. Wikipedia and press both put 43-47 Primark stores in the US. Human check.

Category C = tops (women's tops and T-shirts). Ahrefs top pages for www.primark.com/en-us/ (US, 2026-10-28): after the store locator and department pages (women's /c/women is the largest), the highest-traffic product-type pages are women's pajama sets (est. 630/month) and women's tops and t-shirts (est. 539/month). Tops is the like-for-like item every candidate store sells; pajamas are not. Ahrefs also lists /en-us/a/inspiration/the-lowdown/ordering-online, unread (bot check).
